danish-register-econ.label: Danish registers
danish-register-econ.title: Causal designs in Danish register-data economics
danish-register-econ.description: Identification designs of economics papers that use Statistics Denmark's administrative registers, extracted from the papers by the danish-register-econ pipeline: one record per estimate, grouped into design units and placed in the shared design taxonomy.

danish-register-econ.citation: Johanna Einsiedler (2026). Causal designs in Danish register-data economics [Data set]. https://github.com/johanna-einsiedler/causal-designs/tree/main/data/corpora/danish-register-econ
